name: Tricksy
body:
You are exceptionally gifted at all sorts of trickery and subterfuge.

Prerequisite: Patron deity is a trickster god

Benefit: Three times per day you gain a +2 divine bonus to Bluff, Disable Device, Disguise, Escape Artist, Sleight of Hand or Stealth.
